title: 第3章 议会交锋第4章 深夜访客
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: “谈判?”瑟薇娅冷笑，“谈什么?再签一份《黑水河条约》，把剩下的领土也割让出去?”
外交大臣脸色一变。
“公主殿下，这话可不能乱说——”
“我可没有乱说。”瑟薇娅打断他，“《黑水河条约》签订到现在，我们已经丢了三个行省，赔了五百万金狮币。帝国的胃口只会越来越大。您觉得这次他们会满足于什么?两个行省?还是直接要求我们解散军队?”
外交大臣语塞。
“那您的意思是，我们要跟帝国开战?”坐在对面的商务大臣开口，“公主殿下，您知道战争意味着什么吗?贸易中断，物价飞涨，百姓流离失所——”
“我当然知道。”瑟薇娅看着他，“但您知道屈辱求和意味着什么吗?领土一寸寸被蚕食，国民一代代被奴役，最后连求和的资格都没有。”
商务大臣哑口无言。
这时，坐在角落的一个老贵族站了起来。他穿着老式的礼服，头发花白，声音颤抖。
“公主殿下，您说得对，我们不能屈辱求和。”他顿了顿，“但是，您资助的那位洛加里斯教授，我听到过他的一些传闻，他的一些研究实在太危险了。他提出的那些理论，已经触犯了神的禁区。教廷那边——”
“教廷那边怎么了?”瑟薇娅转头看他。
老贵族咽了口唾沫。
“教廷已经多次向议会施压，要求限制洛加里斯教授的研究。他们说，那位教授的理论，会把我们带向深渊。就像当年的疯王马克西姆——”
“马克西姆。”瑟薇娅重复这个名字，“您是说那位用活人做实验，屠杀了整整三个城市的疯子?”
老贵族点头。
“洛加里斯教授的研究，虽然没有直接杀人，但他对神权的挑战，对传统的破坏，和马克西姆如出一辙。教廷担心，他会成为第二个——”
“够了。”瑟薇娅打断他，“洛加里斯教授的研究，是为了让普通人也能使用魔法科技，让农民能吃饱饭，让士兵能保护家园。他没有用活人做实验，没有屠杀无辜，更没有妄图称王称霸。把他和马克西姆相提并论，是对他最大的侮辱。”
老贵族张了张嘴，想说什么，最后还是坐了回去。
会议桌上一片沉默。
这时，坐在主位上的首相开口了。
“诸位，我们今天还有最后一件事要讨论。”他的声音打破了沉默，“就在上周，北境大公病危，整个北境即将群龙无首。陛下的意思是，需要派遣一位有能力的王室成员，前往北境接管政权。”
所有人的目光都转向了瑟薇娅。
首相翻开一份文件。
“经过慎重考虑，陛下决定，任命瑟薇娅公主为北境代理执政官，全权负责北境事务。”
“这也是那位北境大公的意思”首相补充道
会议桌上炸开了。
“北境?那可是全王国最艰苦的地方!”
“常年冰封，土地贫瘠，连税收都收不上来——”
但瑟薇娅周围的几位议员却是截然不同的反应。一位相貌年轻贵族眼中闪过担忧，却又带着期待。
一位新兴资本家出身的议员则眉头紧锁，小声嘀咕:“如果是公主殿下的话，说不定真能让北境翻身。”
瑟薇娅没有说话，只是静静地看着首相手里的文件。
北境。
那个被称为“王国冰窖”的地方。
贫穷，寒冷，资源匮乏。
但同时也是离帝国中心最远的地方。
首相合上文件。
“公主殿下，您有什么意见吗?”
瑟薇娅站起身。
“我接受。”
周围传来倒吸冷气的声音。
“不过。”瑟薇娅继续，“我需要完全的自主权。人事任免，税收分配，军队调动，我说了算。”
content_en:
"Negotiation?" Servia sneered, "What are you talking about? Sign another "Blackwater River Treaty" and cede the remaining territory?"
The Foreign Minister's expression changed.
"Your Highness, please don't say this nonsense——"
"I'm not talking nonsense." Serviya interrupted him, "Since the signing of the Blackwater River Treaty, we have lost three provinces and lost five million gold lion coins. The empire's appetite will only grow. What do you think they will be satisfied with this time? Two provinces? Or directly ask us to disband the army?"
The Foreign Secretary was at a loss for words.
"Then what you mean is that we are going to go to war with the empire?" The Minister of Commerce sitting opposite said, "Your Highness, do you know what war means? Trade is interrupted, prices are soaring, and people are displaced -"
"Of course I know." Serviya looked at him, "But do you know what it means to humiliate and sue for peace? The territory is being eroded inch by inch, and the citizens are enslaved from generation to generation. In the end, they are not even qualified to sue for peace."
The Business Secretary was speechless.
At this time, an old nobleman sitting in the corner stood up. He wore an old-fashioned dress, had gray hair, and a trembling voice.
"Your Highness Princess, you are right. We cannot humiliate ourselves and seek peace." He paused, "But I have heard some rumors about Professor Logaris you funded, and some of his research is too dangerous. The theories he proposed have violated God's forbidden area. The Holy See -"
"What happened to the Holy See?" Serviya turned to look at him.
The old noble swallowed.
"The Holy See has put pressure on the Parliament many times to restrict Professor Logaris's research. They said that the professor's theory will lead us into the abyss. Just like the Mad King Maxim back then——"
"Maxim." Serviya repeated the name, "You mean the madman who experimented on living people and massacred three entire cities?"
The old nobleman nodded.
"Although Professor Logaris's research did not directly kill people, his challenge to theocratic authority and destruction of tradition are exactly the same as Maxim's. The Holy See is worried that he will become the second -"
"That's enough." Servia interrupted him, "Professor Logaris's research is to allow ordinary people to use magic technology, so that farmers can have enough to eat, and soldiers can protect their homes. He did not conduct experiments on living people, did not massacre innocent people, and did not attempt to become king. Comparing him to Maxim is the greatest insult to him."
The old noble opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but finally sat back.
There was silence on the conference table.
At this time, the Prime Minister sitting on the main seat spoke.
"Everyone, we have one last thing to discuss today." His voice broke the silence. "Just last week, the Grand Duke of the North was critically ill, and the entire North was about to be leaderless. Your Majesty means that a capable member of the royal family needs to be sent to the North to take over the power."
All eyes turned to Serviya.
The Prime Minister opened a document.
"After careful consideration, His Majesty has decided to appoint Princess Serviya as the Acting Consul of the North, who will be fully responsible for the affairs of the North."
"This is also what the Northern Duke meant," the Prime Minister added.
The conference table exploded.
"The North? That's the most difficult place in the whole kingdom!"
“It’s frozen all year round, the land is barren, and we can’t even collect taxes——”
But several members of Congress around Serviya had completely different reactions. A young noble-looking man's eyes flashed with worry, but also with expectation.
A congressman who was an emerging capitalist frowned and whispered: "If it is Her Royal Highness, she might really be able to turn the North around."
Serviya didn't speak, just looked at the documents in the Prime Minister's hand quietly.
Northern Territory.
That place is called "Kingdom Ice Cellar".
Poverty, cold, lack of resources.
But it was also the farthest place from the center of the empire.
The Prime Minister closed the document.
"Your Highness Princess, do you have any comments?"
Serviya stood up.
"I accept."
There were gasps from all around.
"However." Serviya continued, "I need complete autonomy. I have the final say in personnel appointments and dismissals, tax allocation, and military deployment."
